about: Sampleless foundation of the fixed official album master Xtal. Absolute symbolic guides, generic wordless choir (no fetched sample/referenceaudio input/key/TTS/speaker recreation), measured per-source slow dynamics and local acoustic-class percussion.114BPM is an analysis clock not verified bars/tape speed; actualroles/voicing/gear remain hypotheses. No tape/noise/wobble bed or shared default changes. r10: master contour rides (2 passes), per-section level lane, a 1.5 dB clipper drive only in the dense 16-256 s span (the record's crest is ~1.5 dB lower there), half-strength band-width refresh and 0.5 section EQ. r11: in 80-128 s the kick and snare are programmed on the drum stem's grid (griddrums 114.498 BPM, T0 1.529 s; snare hits at half velocity, the transcribed side-sticks kept); master levels, ride and width refit.

xtal-kit.about: Xtal song-local acoustic-class percussion hypothesis. Generated independent short hat exciters for measured stereo air, not the sampled break/hardware or a tape hiss model. No shared default changes.
fx: reverb kind=room decay=1.1s mix=0.16 early=0.8 predelay=8ms

xtal-sub.about: Clean sine sub-bass with a touch of 2nd harmonic; mono, glides slightly. Doubles a distorted bass an octave down or in unison.

xtal-tone.about: Juno-60-style pad: pulse-width-modulated saws through the famous stereo chorus (I+II) — warm, wide, a little hazy. Chillwave, synth-pop, dream pop.

xtal-ah.about: Mixed choir of four synthesised singers (the voice layer: glottal source, five-formant tract) singing 'aah' in a cathedral hall — each with their own tuning, vocal-tract size, breath and place in the stereo field, vibrato blooming after a breathy onset; velocity adds effort and brightness. `^ooh` (or latch `expr.ooh=1`) rounds the vowel to 'ooh', `^mm` hums with closed lips. Chorales, pads, film swells and sacred cadences. The previous subtractive choir is `choir-classic`.
fx: reverb kind=hall decay=2.4s mix=.20 predelay=25ms high_cut=4000
